items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Whenever Clark Terry or Zoot Sims or a lot of other musicians come to Washington, they go straight to Charlotte Fillmore's house.

ctx.x: Osie's mother, who is very much around right now. Whenever Clark Terry or Zoot Sims or a lot of other musicians come to Washington, they go straight to Charlotte Fillmore's house. Or else they call her home, she has them over for dinner and all that. If you ever talk to any of them, if you ask about Charlotte Fillmore, which is Osie Johnson's mother... I am going to call her soon and talk to her. When I do, she'll probably give it to me for not having talked to her since Christmas, because Osie's daughter was…
